prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Seaborgium (Sg) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a night river covered with floating paper lanterns, stone steps leading down to the water
Time of day: night — the scene lit by lamps, screens or windows, dark outside.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: a lingerie set under an open silk night robe with a tied sash — in bright fuchsia; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: sitting on the ground.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the wall.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she lights the wick of a small hand lantern with a long match — her own right hand holds the lit match to the wick, her own left hand steadies the lantern by its base.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — seaborgium: a heavy synthetic metal below chromium, molybdenum and tungsten, first made in 1974 at a hillside laboratory by striking californium with oxygen ions, and the first element named after a person still living: a chemist from a northern mining town who helped find ten elements and, against warnings that it would ruin his name, redrew the periodic table by adding a whole new row of fourteen elements beneath it; a tireless diarist and long-distance walker, whose mailing address could be written in element symbols alone — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
